entries.metric: market capitalization attributable to cryptoassets and digital wallets
entries.subject: Blockchain market value

entries.quote: Our research suggests that the market capitalization of AI hardware and software companies could scale at roughly 50% annualized rate, increasing from $2.5 trillion in 2021 to $87 trillion by 2030.
entries.metric: enterprise value of AI hardware and software companies
entries.subject: AI market value

entries.quote: From 2015 to 2020, the cost to train a GPT-3 sized model dropped 65% at an annual rate, from $875 million to $4.6 million. According to our research, the cost will decline another four orders of magnitude to $500 in 2030.
entries.metric: cost to train a 175B-parameter (GPT-3 sized) model
entries.subject: AI training cost

entries.quote: the cost to train a neural network equivalent in size to the human brain in 2021 would have been $2.5 billion and is likely to drop 60% at an annual rate to $600,000 by 2030.
entries.metric: cost to train a neural network the size of the human brain
entries.subject: AI training cost

entries.quote: Our research suggests that by 2030 AI will increase the output of knowledge workers by 140%.
entries.metric: increase in output of knowledge workers from AI
entries.subject: AI productivity

entries.quote: By 2030, artificial intelligence is likely to boost the output of global knowledge workers by 9% at an annual rate, from $41 trillion in expected human labor output to roughly $97 trillion in AI + human output.
entries.metric: global knowledge worker output (AI plus human)
entries.subject: AI productivity

entries.quote: ARK estimates that organizations will increase spending on enterprise software by 42% at an annual rate to $14 trillion a year.
entries.metric: annual AI software spend
entries.subject: AI software spending
entries.note: p22: 'By 2030, AI software companies could produce $14 trillion in annual revenue collectively.'

entries.quote: By 2030, AI hardware companies could produce $1.7 trillion in annual revenue collectively.
entries.metric: annual AI hardware revenue
entries.subject: AI hardware revenue

entries.quote: we believe the market ... is likely to grow at an 18% compound annual rate during the next five years, from $1.8 trillion today to $4.1 trillion in 2026.
entries.metric: revenue from discretionary online time (entertainment, advertising, platform e-commerce fees)
entries.subject: Digital consumer revenue

entries.quote: By 2030, we expect these averages to flip, with users spending 52% of their free time online and 48% offline.
entries.metric: share of free time spent online
entries.subject: Time spent online

entries.quote: We believe the global digital advertising market will grow at a 11% compound annual rate over the next eight years, surpassing $1 trillion in expenditures by the end of 2029.
entries.metric: global digital advertising expenditure
entries.subject: Digital advertising

entries.quote: We expect social commerce gross merchandise value (GMV) to grow at a compound annual rate of 41% over the next five years to $3.7 trillion, more than doubling it from less than 10% of total e-commerce today to 22% in 2026.
entries.metric: global social commerce GMV
entries.subject: Social commerce
entries.note: Same sentence: 22% of total e-commerce in 2026.

entries.quote: We estimate that video game content and services will grow at a 15% compound annual growth rate from roughly $200 billion in 2021 to more than $400 billion by 2026
entries.metric: global video game content and services revenue
entries.subject: Gaming market

entries.quote: The US Digital Wallet Opportunity Could Scale 69% At An Annual Rate From More Than $400 Billion In 2021 To $5.7 Trillion In 2026.
entries.metric: US digital wallet market capitalization
entries.subject: Digital wallets

entries.quote: The Global Digital Wallet Opportunity Could Scale 78% At An Annual Rate From $1.1 Trillion To $20 Trillion In 2026.
entries.metric: global digital wallet market capitalization
entries.subject: Digital wallets

entries.quote: According to our estimates, the price of one bitcoin could exceed $1 million by 2030.
entries.metric: price of one bitcoin
entries.subject: Bitcoin price
entries.note: Stated price target recorded as a fact only. p55 builds it from use-case market caps totalling about USD 28.5 trillion, or about USD 1.36 million per BTC.

entries.quote: According to our research, Bitcoin's market capitalization could scale more than 25-fold in the next decade
entries.metric: bitcoin market capitalization
entries.subject: Bitcoin network value
entries.note: Slide labels: 25.9x to about USD 28.5 trillion. Horizon stated as 'next decade'; p55 dates the related price claim to 2030. Target year left null: only a relative horizon is stated.

entries.metric: ether market capitalization
entries.subject: Ether network value

entries.quote: By 2030, we expect Web3 to depress annual offline consumption by $7.3 trillion, boosting direct online expenditures at an annual rate of 28%, from $1.4 trillion today to $12.5 trillion per year.
entries.metric: annual direct online expenditures (with Web3)
entries.subject: Online spending
entries.note: p76: without Web3, USD 5.2 trillion in 2030; offline consumption peaks mid-decade at USD 49 trillion.

entries.quote: the equity market capitalization of gene editing and gene therapy companies could grow 54% at a compound annual rate of return, scaling from roughly $130 billion today to $1.1 trillion by 2026.

entries.metric: multi-omics revenue opportunity
entries.subject: Multi-omics market

entries.quote: Based on Wright's Law, ARK forecasts that EV sales will increase roughly eightfold, or a 53% annual rate, from 4.8 million in 2021 to 40 million units in 2026.
entries.metric: global annual battery EV sales
entries.subject: Electric vehicle sales
entries.note: p100: conditional on traditional automakers; about USD 1.2 trillion revenue at USD 30,000 ASP.

entries.quote: EV production costs and sticker prices are likely to drop below those of gas-powered vehicles in the next one to two years and undercut them by 25-35% in 2025.

entries.subject: Electric vehicle price parity

entries.metric: enterprise value of 3D printing and robotics
entries.subject: Robotics market value
